channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: U.S. strikes two Iranian-flagged tankers as tensions continue amid ceasefire
item.description: The US struck two Iranian-flagged tankers amid ongoing tensions. U. S. strikes two Iranian-flagged tankers as tensions continue amid ceasefire The Washington Post.

item.title: UK sends warship to Middle East as Trump awaits Iran’s response to peace plan – live
item.description: The UK sent a warship to the Middle East. UK sends warship to Middle East as Trump awaits Iran’s response to peace plan – live The Independent.

item.title: Iran says it will play at 2026 World Cup if hosts address ‘concerns’
item.description: Iran will play at the 2026 World Cup if hosts address concerns. Iran's presence at the tournament has been shrouded in uncertainty since the US and Israel launched war on the country.

item.title: Iran calls US strikes a ‘reckless military adventure’ as Hormuz clashes test fragile ceasefire
item.description: Iran called US strikes a reckless military adventure. Iran calls US strikes a ‘reckless military adventure’ as Hormuz clashes test fragile ceasefire.

item.title: Attacks Test Fragile Cease-Fire Amid U.S-Iran Negotiations
item.description: Attacks tested a fragile US-Iran cease-fire amid negotiations. Iran War Live Updates: Attacks Test Fragile Cease-Fire Amid U. S-Iran Negotiations The New York Times.

item.title: One Nation Wins Australia Special Election, Claiming Seat in Lower House
item.description: One Nation won a seat in Australia's lower house with David Farley as their candidate. One Nation, an anti-immigration party with Trumpian policies that has risen in popularity, won a seat in Parliament’s lower house for the first time.

item.title: Short-term ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine starts Saturday
item.description: Russia and Ukraine started a short-term ceasefire on Saturday. Short-term ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine starts Saturday WCVB.

item.title: Australia’s populist One Nation scores first-ever lower house victory
item.description: David Farley of One Nation won a lower house seat in Australia's parliament. The far-right party's winning candidate, David Farley, has advocated for stricter migration and farming reforms. Australia’s populist One Nation scores first-ever lower house victory.

item.title: Rhun ap Iorwerth Breaks Labour’s Dominance in Wales
item.description: Rhun ap Iorwerth led his party to the most seats in Wales' parliament. Rhun ap Iorwerth, a former journalist, led his party to the most seats in the Welsh Parliament, ousting the Labour Party, which had long held sway, and beating Reform U. K.

item.title: Russia Has Lost More Than 350,000 Soldiers, New Estimate Finds
item.description: Russia has lost over 350,000 soldiers. The total death toll on both sides may be around half a million. The number raises the prospect that about half a million soldiers in total have died on the Russian and Ukrainian sides.

item.title: An expert on Iranian politics reviews the status of negotiations to end the war on Iran
item.description: Mehrzad Boroujerdi discussed Iran war negotiations with NPR's Elissa Nadworny. NPR's Elissa Nadworny talks to Mehrzad Boroujerdi of the Missouri University of Science and Technology about the status of the Trump Administration's negotiations to end the war on Iran.

item.title: A Less Muscular Victory Day Parade Shows Putin’s Growing Vulnerability
item.description: Putin's Victory Day parade was smaller due to security fears, indicating Moscow's vulnerability. The event, shrunken because of security fears, adds to a sense that Moscow and other Russian cities can no longer be insulated from the war.

item.title: Iran reviewing U.S. proposal at 'own pace' as Trump awaits response, says report
item.description: Iran is reviewing a U. S. proposal at its own pace, according to a report. U. Secretary of State Marco Rubio had indicated Washington expected a response from Iran, but no timeline has been set for a decision.

item.title: ‘Aggressive force armed by NATO’: Putin calls Moscow’s war in Ukraine ‘just’ in Victory Day speech
item.description: Putin called Russia's war in Ukraine "just" in a Victory Day speech, citing NATO's involvement. ‘Aggressive force armed by NATO’: Putin calls Moscow’s war in Ukraine ‘just’ in Victory Day speech WION.

item.title: Australia's far-right party wins first lower house seat
item.description: Australia's far-right party won its first lower house seat, reflecting a global surge in populist support. The ⁠result is in line with a surge of electoral support for far-right populist parties globally.

item.title: North Korea Adopts Policy For Nuclear Strike If Kim Jong Un Is Killed: Report
item.description: North Korea adopted a policy to launch a nuclear strike if Kim Jong Un is killed. Kim Jong-un is also known for strict security measures. North Korea Adopts Policy For Nuclear Strike If Kim Jong Un Is Killed: Report.

item.title: Australian by-election a litmus test for right-wing One Nation Party
item.description: Australia's One Nation Party may win its first parliamentary seat in a by-election in New South Wales. Victory for the populist party in Farrer, New South Wales, would see One Nation's first MP elected to Australia's national parliament.

item.title: The war on Iran will likely end in American retreat
item.description: The US is unlikely to win the war against Iran at acceptable costs. The American empire faces financial, military, and political burdens that may force a retreat. The war's outcome remains uncertain.

item.title: ‘Mosquito fleet,’ ‘Midget submarines’: Iran’s swarm of small vessels choking the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran is using small vessels to choke the Strait of Hormuz. ‘Mosquito fleet,’ ‘Midget submarines’: Iran’s swarm of small vessels choking the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Indian Sailor Dies, 4 Injured After Boat Catches Fire, Sinks Near Hormuz
item.description: An Indian sailor died and four others were injured when their boat caught fire and sank near the Strait of Hormuz. The cause of the fire is still unknown. The exact cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained.
